defective_pattern: Clean-room document generation during revision tasks, obliterating existing draft content.
why_defective: Overwrites prior work, eliminates context, and causes regression in already established content. Violates document conservation principles.
observed_symptoms: Loss of previously generated paragraphs or sections
Drastic reduction in file size or token count during revision
corrective_remedy: Perform in-place docx mutation. Modify only specific sections or paragraphs required by the revision task, preserving all other existing content.
